description: This file is a shell script used for testing git reset commands in bare and non-bare repositories. It contains test cases and setup steps for verifying git behavior under different configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success if the enclosed commands execute without errors.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting failure; the test passes if the command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs and passes if they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
